description: Live preview (gallery.js): animate the Explode/Assemble toggle. When switching between Explode and Assemble, parts should smoothly fly apart and fly back together instead of jumping to the final positions.
test_instructions: Open the live preview, toggle Explode then Assemble; parts animate smoothly apart and back together with no jump.
summary: The live preview in gallery.js jumps parts straight to their final positions when the Explode/Assemble toggle is switched. Parts should animate smoothly, flying apart on Explode and back together on Assemble.
